diagram_previews.alt: Graph of y = sin(sqrt x) for x from 0 to about 170, oscillating between -1 and 1 with humps that widen as x grows. The parts of the x-axis where the graph is on or above the axis, from 0 to pi squared, from 4 pi squared to 9 pi squared, and from 16 pi squared on, are highlighted in red.
